# MCP Registry Documentation

The MCP registry provides MCP clients with a list of MCP servers, like an app store for MCP servers.

## I want to...

- **📤 Publish my MCP server** → [Publishing Guide](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/blob/0b5cc0f6a9ba326d7982b4f03ea7da83bf7817a2/docs/modelcontextprotocol-io/quickstart.mdx)
- **📥 Consume registry data** → [API Usage Guide](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/blob/0b5cc0f6a9ba326d7982b4f03ea7da83bf7817a2/docs/modelcontextprotocol-io/registry-aggregators.mdx)
- **🔌 Understand the registry's purpose** → [Ecosystem vision](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/blob/0b5cc0f6a9ba326d7982b4f03ea7da83bf7817a2/docs/design/ecosystem-vision.md)
- **📋 Look up specific information** → [server.json spec](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/blob/0b5cc0f6a9ba326d7982b4f03ea7da83bf7817a2/docs/reference/server-json/generic-server-json.md) | [API spec](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/blob/0b5cc0f6a9ba326d7982b4f03ea7da83bf7817a2/docs/reference/api/generic-registry-api.md) | [CLI reference](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/blob/0b5cc0f6a9ba326d7982b4f03ea7da83bf7817a2/docs/reference/cli/commands.md)
- **🤝 Add reference to my community project** → [Community Projects](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/blob/0b5cc0f6a9ba326d7982b4f03ea7da83bf7817a2/docs/community-projects.md)

## Documentation Index

- 📄 [Public-facing docs](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/blob/0b5cc0f6a9ba326d7982b4f03ea7da83bf7817a2/docs/modelcontextprotocol-io) - Published on modelcontextprotocol.io
- 🏗️ [Design documentation](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/blob/0b5cc0f6a9ba326d7982b4f03ea7da83bf7817a2/docs/design) - Architecture, vision, and roadmap
- 📖 [Reference](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/blob/0b5cc0f6a9ba326d7982b4f03ea7da83bf7817a2/docs/reference) - Technical specifications
- 🔧 [Contributing guides](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/blob/0b5cc0f6a9ba326d7982b4f03ea7da83bf7817a2/docs/contributing) - How to contribute
- 🔒 [Administration](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/blob/0b5cc0f6a9ba326d7982b4f03ea7da83bf7817a2/docs/administration) - Admin operations
